sources.title: eTransit Punjab route planner, get-line-schedules (line 71, route 441), fetched 2026-09-25

routes.notes: Official PMA eTransit listing (line 71 'PTC Electric Bus (MZA)', district Muzaffarabad). eTransit lists only the two terminals; intermediate stops are not published. The route runs via Gojra Bypass. Timetable on 2026-09-25: 22 departures from the first terminal (06:00-20:00) and 23 from the other (06:20-21:00); hours = first to last departure. Coordinates are eTransit's own points (not OSM), as in punjab-round2. 'Industrial Area Chella' is spelled Chehla locally. Route id is ours (MZA- + eTransit route id).
